info.title: LiveChat API
info.description: Multi-tenant live chat backend. Envelope: `{success, data, meta?}` / `{success:false, error:{code,message,details?}}`. Dashboard routes use a Bearer access JWT; widget routes use a Bearer visitor token issued by `/public/widgets/{publicKey}/visitors/init`.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token (body or httpOnly cookie)
Accept invitation (token must match caller email)

get.summary: List members (OWNER and AGENT are both Users)

post.summary: Rotate public key (breaks existing embeds + visitor sessions)

get.summary: Unassigned queue - identical for every OWNER/AGENT

post.summary: Atomic claim. First writer wins; others get 409 ALREADY_ASSIGNED. Idempotent for the current assignee (meta.claimed=false).
Return to queue (own conversation, or OWNER)
Send. First visitor-visible reply implicitly claims an unassigned conversation (meta.claimed). INTERNAL_NOTE never reaches the visitor.

get.summary: List MY shortcuts in this workspace. ?all=true returns the full sorted list for the '/' composer.

post.summary: Create (leading slash optional; lowercased; unique per user+workspace)
Upload (multipart field 'file'). Returns an id to pass as attachmentIds when sending.

get.summary: Public config (whitelisted, cached in Redis) + live availability. Origin must match the website's domain/allowedDomains.

post.summary: Create/refresh visitor; returns visitorToken (JWT, separate secret)
Start (or continue the open) conversation with a first message. Enters the unassigned queue.
Send (type derived server-side; reopens a closed conversation)

get.summary: Download - only files from the visitor's own conversations
Get verification instructions (DNS TXT / meta tag / file upload)

post.summary: Run a live verification check for one method
